underlying_problem: Staff copy information from emailed forms and scanned assessments into participant and worker records in the relevant systems.
automation_opportunity: Import original forms, extract draft fields, validate required values and match existing identities before native entry.
human_boundary: Office or HR approves identity and changed fields.
completion_evidence: Original source, approved fields and verified native ID are linked.

underlying_problem: Website, email, telephone, coordinator and provider referrals require manual collection and processing.
automation_opportunity: Capture authorized email, form and staff-logged phone referrals into one deduplicated owned case.
human_boundary: Office confirms uncertain referral identity.
completion_evidence: One source produces one owned enquiry with a next action.

underlying_problem: People can complete intake paperwork before learning that OCD cannot serve their area.
automation_opportunity: Check the approved service area before the full intake; route uncertain areas to staff review.
human_boundary: Coordinator confirms actual capacity.
completion_evidence: No geographic result is presented as a reserved service.

underlying_problem: Missing dates create clarification and follow-up work. The intended date field still needs confirmation.
automation_opportunity: Define the intended date field, validate it and assign clarification for missing or ambiguous dates.
human_boundary: Intake owner approves the form definition.
completion_evidence: Required date meaning and source are recorded.

underlying_problem: Staff search prospect and active-client lists; a consultation record was reportedly moved to active status prematurely.
automation_opportunity: Use explicit enquiry, consultation and active stages with transition checks against the native record.
human_boundary: Office approves activation.
completion_evidence: Consultation cannot silently become an active service.

underlying_problem: Approved hours and service changes must be recovered from emails and notes, with uncertainty about whether a colleague recorded the update.
automation_opportunity: Link approved service hours and effective changes to their source and affected bookings.
human_boundary: Coordinator approves the allocation change.
completion_evidence: Saved schedule agrees with the approved instruction.

underlying_problem: Multiple administrators inspect the same messages while other enquiries remain unanswered.
automation_opportunity: Deduplicate incoming messages and show assigned owner, due time and response status.
human_boundary: Office resolves conflicting ownership.
completion_evidence: One actionable enquiry has one accountable owner.

underlying_problem: Staff repeatedly check Outlook, Dialpad, messages and voicemail while performing other work.
automation_opportunity: Use the existing Graph delta collector for authorized email and owned manual references for unsupported phone events.
human_boundary: Office confirms available call-event access.
completion_evidence: New work is visible without treating unread status as ownership.
n8n_role: Optional connector for an approved additional channel

underlying_problem: Similar emails and updates are prepared participant by participant.
automation_opportunity: Prepare messages from reviewed templates and an approved delivery outbox.
human_boundary: Office approves recipient and content.
completion_evidence: Delivery result or owned failure is retained.
n8n_role: Optional delivery adapter behind the application API

underlying_problem: Messages can omit the person, service time, confirmed outcome or next action.
automation_opportunity: Validate person, date/time, confirmed change and next action before a message is approved.
human_boundary: Office checks the actual message.
completion_evidence: Required context is present before sending.

underlying_problem: Staff separately check whether people were notified, received the message or responded.
automation_opportunity: Track approval, dispatch, provider receipt, response and failed delivery as separate states.
human_boundary: Office handles uncertain receipt or no response.
completion_evidence: A sent action is never treated as acknowledged without evidence.

underlying_problem: Establishing what was communicated requires searching across channels, while protecting access to confidential information.
automation_opportunity: Index authorized communication references against the person and case with role-based access.
human_boundary: Office controls disclosure and history scope.
completion_evidence: Reviewer can locate the relevant communication without cross-role leakage.

underlying_problem: Staff identify urgent requests, connect complaints to the relevant invoice or booking, and decide who should act.
automation_opportunity: Suggest category and urgency and retrieve candidate booking/invoice references for review.
human_boundary: Office verifies identity, urgency and the relevant record.
completion_evidence: Uncertain matches remain assigned exceptions.

underlying_problem: Participants call the office to ask whether a worker is on the way or why the worker has not arrived, adding interruptions.
automation_opportunity: Evaluate native arrival visibility first; if a gap remains, expose a consented, fresh ETA for the assigned service.
human_boundary: Office and worker confirm sharing scope.
completion_evidence: Stale, reassigned or unauthorized estimates are withdrawn.

underlying_problem: Coverage depends on location, worker hours, departures, preferences and actual capacity, rather than postcode alone.
automation_opportunity: Combine configured area checks with a coordinator capacity decision and current roster evidence.
human_boundary: Coordinator decides capacity and negotiated exceptions.
completion_evidence: Coverage information does not overpromise available workers.

underlying_problem: An empty calendar slot does not establish willingness or availability to accept work; worker confirmation is still required.
automation_opportunity: Check roster/leave and record worker acceptance before confirming a proposed booking change.
human_boundary: Worker and participant confirm the arrangement.
completion_evidence: An unbooked slot alone cannot confirm work.

underlying_problem: Staff copy existing bookings and change dates, times, workers, service details and travel information.
automation_opportunity: Prepare a booking draft from reviewed call details and validate dates, service and overlaps.
human_boundary: Coordinator performs unsupported creation in ShiftCare.
completion_evidence: One correctly scoped native booking is read back.

underlying_problem: Staff clarify whether a change affects one occurrence or future bookings before editing.
automation_opportunity: Preview one-occurrence versus future-series effects and retain the approved scope.
human_boundary: Coordinator authorizes the recurrence scope.
completion_evidence: Native changes match the approved occurrence set.

underlying_problem: AM/PM and service-time misunderstandings require clarification and correction.
automation_opportunity: Use explicit date, timezone and 24-hour previews before saving reviewed times.
human_boundary: Coordinator checks exceptional times.
completion_evidence: The saved occurrence has the intended timestamp.

underlying_problem: Staff reopen records and future occurrences to check that changes saved correctly. The cause of an apparent failed update was not established.
automation_opportunity: Retrieve the saved native record and compare expected fields before reporting completion.
human_boundary: Office reconciles mismatched or unknown results.
completion_evidence: Completion requires matching native evidence.

underlying_problem: Addresses, kilometres, travel duration and separate travel/service blocks require checking.
automation_opportunity: Calculate proposed route estimates and compare travel/service blocks using confirmed addresses.
human_boundary: Coordinator or payroll reviewer approves eligible travel treatment.
completion_evidence: Route estimates remain distinct from actual mileage and pay.

underlying_problem: Worker or booking changes can leave previous travel values in place.

human_boundary: Coordinator reviews the changed travel context.
completion_evidence: A stale estimate cannot remain silently approved.

underlying_problem: A departing worker's bookings require reassignment, travel review and participant communication, even where future-shift updates are available.

completion_evidence: Every affected native occurrence and required notice is checked.

underlying_problem: Staff chase participants or families to establish when workers should attend.
automation_opportunity: Create deadline-driven clarification tasks for unconfirmed service times.
human_boundary: Office obtains the participant or family decision.
completion_evidence: Final agreed time is recorded before confirmation.

underlying_problem: Staff inspect bookings individually and copy missing shift or timesheet instructions.
automation_opportunity: Identify missing instructions and preview application of an approved instruction template to selected bookings.
human_boundary: Coordinator approves wording and affected scope.
completion_evidence: Correct instructions are verified on the intended bookings.

underlying_problem: Instructions are rewritten and formatted in separate tools, with manual before/after tracking.
automation_opportunity: Keep reviewed instruction versions, effective dates and change history with structured fields.
human_boundary: Procedure owner approves the current version.
completion_evidence: Staff can identify which wording applies to a booking.

underlying_problem: Staff manually inspect reminder responses and determine the required action.
automation_opportunity: Match native reminder replies to the exact occurrence and route yes/no/change exceptions.
human_boundary: Office resolves ambiguous identity or occurrence.
completion_evidence: Silence and ambiguous replies never cancel a service.

underlying_problem: A worker can be notified while the corresponding booking remains active.

human_boundary: Office checks unresolved native or contact steps.
completion_evidence: Notification alone cannot close the cancellation.

underlying_problem: Provider travel and mileage require separate review and cleanup when travel did not occur.

completion_evidence: Travel lines and cancellation status both match the approved result.

underlying_problem: Staff distinguish participant cancellations from provider inability to deliver, then establish the approved billing treatment.

human_boundary: Bookkeeper or authorized manager approves the policy.
completion_evidence: Exact occurrence and money consequences are approved together.

underlying_problem: Sickness and resignations trigger urgent coordination and roster changes.

human_boundary: Coordinator obtains available-worker and participant decisions.
completion_evidence: Every affected service has a confirmed outcome or owned escalation.

underlying_problem: Several simultaneous absences can exceed the available replacement pool.

underlying_problem: Each affected participant may prefer replacement cover, rescheduling or skipping the visit, requiring individual confirmation.

underlying_problem: Staff consider geography, availability, continuity, introductions and participant agreement.

completion_evidence: No autonomous assignment is made from distance alone.

underlying_problem: Files must be located across email, cloud storage and ShiftCare.

human_boundary: Office confirms the correct person and document.
completion_evidence: Original and native document references are findable together.

underlying_problem: Received documents must be matched and placed under the correct person.

completion_evidence: The intended native record contains the correct file and metadata.

underlying_problem: Staff open individual records to establish whether required paperwork is present. A missing native copy does not prove the agreement does not exist.

completion_evidence: Missing native copy is not equated with absent agreement.

underlying_problem: Emails can refer to documents that were not attached, creating another follow-up.

completion_evidence: The referenced document is actually available to the intended recipient.

underlying_problem: Staff interpret date formats and distinguish plan dates from agreement dates; an initial expired-plan interpretation was corrected in the discussion.

underlying_problem: Updated dates, funding information and supporting evidence require external clarification.

completion_evidence: Verified update is linked to the correct native record.

underlying_problem: Non-expiring documents can appear expired because their metadata was entered incorrectly.

completion_evidence: Correct native metadata is read back before an alert is resolved.

underlying_problem: Genuine missing or expiring worker documents require checking and follow-up.

underlying_problem: Cleaning/support categories and travel items can be mismatched and require correction.

underlying_problem: Advance payments and special billing arrangements depend on notes and recollection.

underlying_problem: Staff select and verify invoice tax and accounting settings against the approved instructions.

completion_evidence: Native draft/export reflects the approved mapping.

underlying_problem: Plan-manager changes may not be communicated before invoices are issued.
automation_opportunity: Flag payer/contact changes and maintain stable native/Xero ID links with verification dates.

completion_evidence: Unverified recipient changes cannot silently redirect billing.

underlying_problem: Staff locate the rejected invoice, establish the reason and determine the correction.

human_boundary: Bookkeeper chooses amendment or reissue treatment.
completion_evidence: Corrected external reference and checked outcome are retained.

underlying_problem: Calls, messages, resending and payment verification require staff follow-through.
automation_opportunity: Use authorized Xero status reads/events to prepare owned follow-ups and approved contact actions.
human_boundary: Accounts owner confirms outcome and contact.
completion_evidence: Paid/closed state requires current external evidence.

underlying_problem: Staff repeatedly clarify when completed services should be invoiced; the discussion did not establish one definitive new schedule.
automation_opportunity: Configure reviewed cutoffs and completed-service review periods only after the billing cadence is agreed.
human_boundary: Bookkeeper approves calendar and scope.
completion_evidence: No unapproved production billing schedule is inferred.

underlying_problem: Unusual amounts or unclear instructions are handed to experienced staff; general escalation criteria remain to be agreed.

completion_evidence: Exception has a named reviewer and recorded disposition.

underlying_problem: Rounding or export issues require correction; the client described these as lower priority.

underlying_problem: Owners report concern that returned invoices delay the cash needed for wages.
automation_opportunity: Show verified overdue/returned balances and outstanding follow-up; measure correction delays.
human_boundary: Management handles actual cash commitments and funding decisions.
completion_evidence: Reporting does not promise payment timing or payroll liquidity.

underlying_problem: Period dates, payment dates and payment methods require checking. Weekly/fortnightly wording in the transcript remains unclear.
automation_opportunity: Align approved native pay periods, staff links and pay items before duplicating data transfer.
human_boundary: Payroll officer confirms the calendar and vendor.
completion_evidence: Native draft timesheet export matches the real pay period.

underlying_problem: Inactive workers can remain in payroll selection and need review.
automation_opportunity: Compare the run population with current staff status and surface leaver/starter exceptions.

underlying_problem: Adding an employee requires a separate payroll setup process whose complete steps were not supplied.

underlying_problem: Staff inspect and refresh information carried over from earlier payslips. The field described as a base rate needs verification.

completion_evidence: No inferred reset changes a contractual wage rate.

underlying_problem: Staff compare ShiftCare hours and mileage with payroll inputs and manually enter the approved values.

human_boundary: Payroll officer reviews external draft totals.
completion_evidence: Actual entry is reconciled without another competing export path.

underlying_problem: Incomplete source records require investigation before payroll can proceed.

completion_evidence: Missing data is never treated as zero hours.

completion_evidence: Changed sources invalidate the reviewed preparation draft.

underlying_problem: Corrections require calculations, approval, entry and explanatory notes.

completion_evidence: External payroll reference and correction history are checked.

underlying_problem: Kilometres, reimbursement amounts and payroll fields require careful distinction; the transcript does not establish a reimbursement rate.
automation_opportunity: Enforce separate distance/time/currency fields after reimbursement rules and units are approved.
human_boundary: Payroll officer confirms units and rate source.
completion_evidence: Kilometres cannot be silently interpreted as dollars.

underlying_problem: Home-to-first-job changes need an approved decision and communication before application.
automation_opportunity: Hold first-job travel changes pending approved treatment, effective date and required communication.
human_boundary: Authorized manager/payroll approves the rule.
completion_evidence: A pending policy discussion cannot change payments.

underlying_problem: Staff save, finalize and email payslips employee by employee in the external payroll process.
automation_opportunity: Use the established payroll system for pay-run finalization and payslip delivery; track only the checked handoff.
human_boundary: Authorized payroll officer releases the run.
completion_evidence: A local worksheet is not treated as payment or payslip delivery.

underlying_problem: Owners describe missed tasks, inconsistent cleaning and early departures requiring investigation; these are reported concerns about service delivery.
automation_opportunity: Present factual task-completion, attendance and feedback exceptions for supervisor review.
human_boundary: Supervisor investigates service concerns.
completion_evidence: No worker performance conclusion is inferred automatically.

underlying_problem: Significant events and extra time must be found among routine visit records, including restricted office notes.
automation_opportunity: Flag source-defined significant-note and duration exceptions with restricted access and original links.
human_boundary: Responsible staff assess significance and existing escalation.
completion_evidence: Summary does not replace care records or urgent incident response.

underlying_problem: Staff arrange calls to learn how services are going.
automation_opportunity: Schedule agreed feedback tasks and retain participant responses and resulting actions.

completion_evidence: Feedback has an owner and unresolved concerns remain visible.

underlying_problem: The supervisor wants proactive feedback so concerns can be raised before relying on incoming complaints.

completion_evidence: No automated satisfaction or clinical judgement closes a concern.

completion_evidence: Case access and resolution evidence match the approved process.

completion_evidence: Personnel case and service cover have separately verified outcomes.

completion_evidence: Software task status cannot replace urgent safety escalation.

underlying_problem: Staff rely on personal notes and long recordings to recover instructions.

human_boundary: Procedure owner maintains accuracy.
completion_evidence: Staff can retrieve the current instructions for the task.

underlying_problem: Supervisors revisit procedures when knowledge has not been retained.

human_boundary: Trainer checks understanding and readiness.
completion_evidence: Reading or watching alone does not mark competence complete.

underlying_problem: New staff require substantial direct instruction and supervision.
automation_opportunity: Reuse approved training materials and distribute named trainer ownership.
human_boundary: Management funds and provides supervision.
completion_evidence: Time released is measured, not assumed from a checklist.

human_boundary: Case owner verifies the actual outcome.
completion_evidence: An unfinished native update cannot be hidden by a sent message.

underlying_problem: Supplying documents does not establish that staff read or understood them.

completion_evidence: Acknowledgement is not treated as proven compliant behavior.
